verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents multiple AI-generated insight features: Copilot code review that 'analyzes your pull requests and suggests improvements,' Copilot chat that 'provides insights into both public and private repositories,' and Copilot agent tasks management, all surfaced directly in the mobile app on the user's own repo data. This directly matches the story of getting AI-generated insights/suggestions from one's data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically of the Copilot features' quality (community evidence only covers non-AI app bugs/UX issues, not the AI insight features themselves).
